name: ytm
description: YouTube Music desktop app for Windows
author: YTM Contributors

scripts.build: tsc && node scripts/bundle-renderer.js && cpx "src/renderer/**/*.html" dist/renderer && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: tsc && node scripts/bundle-renderer.js && cpx "src/renderer/**/*.html" dist/renderer && electron-builder --linux --x64 --config electron-builder.linux.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux:deb: tsc && node scripts/bundle-renderer.js && cpx "src/renderer/**/*.html" dist/renderer && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --config electron-builder.linux.yml --publish never
